# Templates and generated files name the tool pforret/mkdox2, never the old pforret/mkdox

## Context
The item was only about `build -I` calling the old `mkdox` tool in mkdox2.sh. While testing, the regenerated `about/index.md` said "Generated by pforret/mkdox", and every template's `zensical.toml` started with `# generated by pforret/mkdox v{MKDOX_VERSION}`, which pairs the old repo name with mkdox2's version number.

## Options considered
- Fix only mkdox2.sh (spec): new projects keep naming the wrong tool.
- Also rename it in the 6 zensical.toml headers and the 2 index.post files: 8 one-word edits, same old-name problem.

## Decision
Templates and generated files name the tool pforret/mkdox2, never the old pforret/mkdox

## Consequences
New projects say `pforret/mkdox2` everywhere. `pforret/mkdox` is the separate, older MkDocs-based tool; don't refer to it in templates, hints or help text (see also the earlier `$script_prefix` decision).
